# Hotel Astoria Alba Iulia

> Hotel 3★ în Alba Iulia cu 30 camere, restaurant internațional, Astoria Pool Park și săli de evenimente. Parte a Floreagrup.

## Site structure

- https://astoriahotels.ro — Home
- https://astoriahotels.ro/camere — Room listing (apartment, standard, standard-balcon)
- https://astoriahotels.ro/restaurant — International cuisine restaurant
- https://astoriahotels.ro/pool-park — Heated pool, jacuzzi, water bar
- https://astoriahotels.ro/evenimente — Events: weddings, baptisms, parties
- https://astoriahotels.ro/sustenabilitate — Green energy, eco filtration
- https://astoriahotels.ro/welcome-to-alba — Alba Iulia guide
- https://astoriahotels.ro/blog — Blog & travel guides
- https://astoriahotels.ro/blog/ce-pot-vizita-in-alba-iulia-in-24-de-ore — What to visit in Alba Iulia in 24 hours
- https://astoriahotels.ro/contact — Contact & map
